#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

int main() {
    std::ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    std::cin.tie(nullptr);
    
    int tam;
    std::cin >> tam;
    std::string cad;
    std::cin >> cad;
    
    std::vector<std::string> arr;
    int cont = 0;
    int mayor = 0;
    bool flg = false;
    std::string word;
    
    for (int i = 0; i < tam; ++i) {
        char ch = cad[i];
        
        if (ch == '(') {
            if (cont >= mayor) {
                mayor = cont;
            }
            cont = 0;
            flg = true;
        } else if (ch == ')') {
            flg = false;
            if (!word.empty()) {
                arr.push_back(word);
                word.clear();
            }
        } else if (flg) {
            if (ch != '_') {
                word.push_back(ch);
            } else if (!word.empty()) {
                arr.push_back(word);
                word.clear();
            }
        } else if (ch != '_') {
            cont++;
            if (i == tam - 1 && cont >= mayor) {
                mayor = cont;
            }
        } else {
            if (cont >= mayor) {
                mayor = cont;
            }
            cont = 0;
        }
    }
    
    std::cout << mayor << " " << arr.size() << std::endl;
    return 0;
}
